title: Reset original productdb and seed root administrator
scope: Only localhost:5432/productdb public schema; do not create or start databases, containers, or volumes and do not access other databases or schemas.
plan: Record and verify the target connection identity and current public table list.
Drop every table in public, including existing application tables and schema_migrations, without using DROP DATABASE.
Run the existing backend migration mechanism from migration 001 through the final migration (expected 020), then verify schema_migrations has the final version and dirty=false.

Inspect the resulting members schema and existing password-hashing and authorization conventions before creating username=root and email=root@gmail.com with a bcrypt password hash, member_type=employee, and permission=admin.
Run repeatable migration/reset and root-seed verification coverage without recording any real password, then run gofmt, go test ./..., and explicit database verification queries.
safety: All database commands must explicitly use host localhost, port 5432, and database productdb; stop on any uncertainty or migration incompatibility.
